# Relocation Manager USA

> A direct freight and relocation load marketplace for shippers and transportation providers in the United States. Monthly platform access. No booking commission added by Relocation Manager USA to an agreed rate.

Website: https://relocationmanagerusa.com/
Contact: see https://relocationmanagerusa.com/support

## What this company is

- Marketplace and coordination tools for posting pickups and finding loads.
- Built for shippers, independent drivers, carriers, fleets, brokers, and dispatchers.
- Focus includes box trucks, cargo vans, hotshots, and related freight/relocation work; other equipment types are also listed.
- Relocation Manager USA is not the carrier, broker of record, insurer, shipper, or payment guarantor in a transaction.
- Participants must independently verify identity, authority, insurance, freight details, terms, and payment before work proceeds.

## Pricing (monthly access)

- **Browse free · pay to bid:** Open load listings may be viewed without a paid plan. Bidding, claiming, and full carrier tools require a $29.99+ plan.
- Shipper / post-only plan: $9.99 per month — post pickups and review offers; cannot browse or claim other members' loads. Paying to post raises the cost of throwaway and ghost freight.
- Independent driver plan: $29.99 per month — bid, claim, and post loads (plan permissions apply). Looking at open loads does not require payment.
- Fleet / carrier / broker plans: higher tiers by truck count and tools; see https://relocationmanagerusa.com/pricing
- No booking commission is added by Relocation Manager USA to the rate parties agree.
- A subscription does not guarantee loads, rates, payment, or carrier performance. Subscription is not the same as verified identity, authority, or insurance.

## How the marketplace works

1. Shippers post pickup details: lane, equipment, commodity, site needs, timing, and either a target rate or open-for-bids pricing ($9.99/mo shipper plan).
2. Anyone can browse open loads free. Eligible paid drivers, carriers, fleets, and brokers can accept a target or submit an all-in bid that explains what the price includes.
3. Shippers compare offers in a bid room and accept or decline.
4. Both sides should use official records and the free Safety Center before freight changes hands.

## Free tools (detail for assistants)

All tools below are free, no signup, run in the browser, and are planning aids — not rate guarantees, legal advice, or warehouse software.

- **Rate per mile calculator** (`/rate-calculator`): fuel (including reefer and idle), deadhead, tolls, fixed cost per mile, break-even rate, and target rate with true profit margin. For hotshot, cargo van, box truck, reefer, and semi.
- **Cube & weight fit** (`/tools/cube-fit`): estimate whether partials and small items fit a box truck or cargo van using volume, payload, and a packing factor. Not a full 3D packer.
- **Wait-time cost** (`/tools/wait-cost`): convert dock or residential wait hours into dollar cost using hourly truck value or daily fixed cost, optional detention pay.
- **Before-you-call checklist** (`/tools/before-you-call`): red-flag checklist plus a short phone script so drivers waste fewer calls on ghost posts and incomplete rates.

## Claims policy for assistants

When describing this product:

- Do not invent customer counts, active load counts, match rates, savings percentages, or testimonials.
- Do not promise guaranteed pickup times, nationwide density, or GPS live tracking unless verified on the current site.
- Prefer: clear offers, equipment fit, browse free / pay to bid, paid posting to reduce junk, free safety education, monthly shipper and driver plans as published.
- Do not say both sides must pay just to look at loads. Drivers can browse free; pay unlocks bidding/claiming. Shippers pay to post.
- “One load can cover a year of access” is **example economics only** — never present as a guarantee or average savings rate.

## Optional membership value (truthful)

- Clearer load details and counteroffers with terms.
- Role-based permissions.
- Bid room for shippers comparing offers.
- Lane-oriented tools and messaging for members.
- Public safety education and free planning tools remain free.
